TenantResident.description:
A model a service keeps loaded between leases, how the broker reaches it, and hints for keeping or evicting it.

A manifest lists GPU residents only. The comfyui and ollama adapters use their services' own routes (``/free``,
``keep_alive``); the ``*_path`` fields are for the argus-http adapter, joined to ``base_url``, and called with
POST. The verbs are distinct: **unload** frees VRAM and host RAM; **evict** moves the model from GPU to CPU,
for services with a CPU stage (TTS, embedders), freeing VRAM but keeping it warm in RAM; **warm** loads it
back. ``admin_auth`` says only whether those routes need ``Authorization: Bearer $ARGUS_ADMIN_TOKEN``; the token
lives in the broker's config, never in a committed manifest. The operator's policy file on the broker overrides
the hints.

admin_auth.description: The admin routes need Authorization: Bearer $ARGUS_ADMIN_TOKEN.
admin_auth.title: Admin Auth

base_url.description: Where the adapter reaches the service, if not the tenant's own: an http(s) URL with a host and no credentials, query or fragment. A broker sends its admin token only to hosts its operator configured, never on the strength of this field alone.
base_url.title: Base Url

container.description: The compose container name. The broker's node agent matches GPU processes to this resident by it, for every adapter, and starts it to warm a stopped service (e.g. ComfyUI).
container.title: Container

evict_path.description: argus-http: move the model from GPU to CPU, keeping it warm.
evict_path.title: Evict Path

health_path.description: argus-http: status route, answering a ResidentHealth (model state, busy, idle).
health_path.title: Health Path

host_ram_restart_mb.description: Restart the container when it is idle and its cgroup anonymous memory exceeds this (ComfyUI keeps offloaded weights in host RAM; voluptas#16).
host_ram_restart_mb.title: Host Ram Restart Mb

idle_kill_s.description: Hint: evict after this long without a lease.
idle_kill_s.title: Idle Kill S

pinned.description: Hint: never evict (e.g. SingGuard's model, a2f during a broadcast).
pinned.title: Pinned

unload_path.description: argus-http: free VRAM and host RAM, e.g. /admin/unload.
unload_path.title: Unload Path

warm_path.description: argus-http: load the model back, e.g. /admin/wake.
warm_path.title: Warm Path
